A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the large-strain PT problem under compression in a DAC is a coupled process of phase transformations and plastic flow.
the PTs are controlled by the yield strength ratio of low- to high-pressure phases, and the transformation kinetics has a strong effect on the PTs only when the yield strength ratio is small.
, in order to obtain reliable data on phase transformation kinetics, one needs to control the yield strength of the sample and to measure the pressure distribution in the sample.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, in general, PTs under pressure are accompanied by a large plastic deformation of a sample.
the transformation kinetics and yield strengths of the high- and low-pressure phases have to be taken into account for the interpretation of experimental results and for the characterization of PTs.
the kinetics of a PT is an essential factor in understanding the large-strain behavior of a material under high-pressure compression.
